purpose: Isolated supplied development SQL planner check; not full-agent evaluation
question: For each portfolio, show the total value of Technology sector holdings and what percentage it represents of the total portfolio value

actual.sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name, tech_val.tech_market_value, total_val.total_market_value, ROUND(100.0 * tech_val.tech_market_value / total_val.total_market_value, 2) AS percentage_of_total FROM portfolios p INNER JOIN (SELECT h.portfolio_id, SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price) AS total_market_value FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON h.security_id = s.security_id GROUP BY h.portfolio_id) total_val ON p.portfolio_id = total_val.portfolio_id INNER JOIN (SELECT h.portfolio_id, SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price) AS tech_market_value FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON h.security_id = s.security_id JOIN sectors sec ON s.sector_id = sec.sector_id WHERE sec.sector_name = 'Technology' GROUP BY h.portfolio_id) tech_val ON p.portfolio_id = tech_val.portfolio_id ORDER BY percentage_of_total DESC
